summary: This study compares two different drug treatment plans for adults with newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes, which is a condition of high blood sugar. Researchers want to see how well these treatment plans control blood sugar and help patients achieve diabetes remission. The study plans to enroll 240 participants between 18 and 65 years old. Participants are divided into two groups to receive either semaglutide or oral medications combined with other drugs.
